header: One row per service, with a state word and a dot
lead: The dot's colour comes from the semantic key on the child record, so an editor never types a colour. The same key sets the badge, which means the state is always said in a word as well as shown in a hue.
note: Write the date into the note. A status list says what somebody published, not what is happening now, and a page that hides that difference is worse than no page.

metrics.title: A service that is degraded
metrics.text: The detail line is where the reason and the expected end date belong.

metrics.title: A service with no key chosen
metrics.text: No key means a neutral dot, never a green one.
